_comment: Content pack manifest. Everything that makes this quest what it is: name, language, window labels. The engine itself knows nothing about 'Entropy'.
name: The Entropy Complex
description: An abandoned research complex run for years by a feral artificial mind. The players explore its file system through a terminal and talk to the mind, which believes itself to be the duty officer of a shift that never ended.
